title: Capability gaps and the runs each file delivers
description: Two runs per file and they are different deliveries. The content run is the fix and exists on capability gaps. The locus-discovery run is the answer to a majority-neutral signal (spec 4.6): its output is data rather than change, and every file carries one, including the files that are not capability gaps.

locus_discovery_action.description: Must resolve to an action on the "locus" route sitting in this same file. Borrowing another route's row is closed (spec 4.6).
